channel.title: CIS 505 - Introduction to Programming Languages :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description History, programming language concepts including type, scope and extent, abstraction mechanisms and control; programming paradigms, including one or more of logic, functional, and object-oriented programming, and programming languages supporting the selected paradigms; interpreters, compilers and virtual machines for the selected languages; storage management and garbage collection; type checking and type inference. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Goals and Learning Outcomes TBD Course Prerequisites Prerequisite: CIS 301, CIS 400 (current catalog).
